title: Tamarind Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired curry made with juicy chicken, tamarind, and spices.

ingredients.name: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tamarind paste, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with naan.
